callGraph.callee:
[
    item.category,
    item.name,
    item.description,
    item.source,
    item.acceptsArgs ? "args" : "no-args",
    item.skillName ?? "",
    item.skillPath ? normalizeWorkspacePath(item.skillPath) : "",
    item.skillScope ?? "",
    item.serverName ?? "",
  ].join

functions.name: useSubmitMessage
params:
{
  refs,
  draftSessionId,
  replyTargetEventId,
  flushDraft,
  clearReplyTarget,
  imageAttachment,
  citeCode,
  handleSessChatSubmit,
  onSubmitOverride,
  submitDisabled = false,
}
